items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: He was the smoothest, satiny-est bass player I ever saw, and I wanted to adapt my playing after him

ctx.x: Noble Sissle. Ed Cole was playing with Noble Sissle.
Yes, he was a bass player. He was the smoothest, satiny-est bass player I ever saw, and I wanted to adapt my playing after him, along with John Kirby and Billy Taylor, Sr. That's my style.
